answer: The gatehouse is Accredited pilot pilotage record with pilots endorsement. Passing it takes 5-year yard service, 150 supervised leadings, master review, annual re-assessment, and every alias must pass alone. Every alias pays its own way: 119 POA locked, 15 minutes spent, and 604 aliases means 71876 POA gone. Count the quartz in the file, count the delta in the wallet, and count the quill in the years: the numbers never favour the farm. The mechanism is old, the price is honest, and the record is open to all.
